name: yukibana-cloud
description: The local stack and its checks. The app is under app/, the CLI under cli/, the database under supabase/.

scripts.install:all: npm ci && npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix cli ci
scripts.check: npm --prefix app run lint && npm --prefix app run typecheck && npm --prefix app test && npm --prefix cli run lint && npm --prefix cli run typecheck && npm --prefix cli test
scripts.build: npm --prefix app ci && npm --prefix app run build
